source.source_text: Purpose: bounded tail from an allowlisted log source. Input: source:string, lines?:1..2000, since_seconds?:integer. Output: sanitized log entries plus truncation state. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.log.read; target log_source; timeout 10000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem allowlisted_logs; secret-pattern redaction mandatory; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
